Playlist downloads are now available from the terminal interface.

### Highlights

- **Download a complete playlist.** Paste a playlist URL in `nah`, review its entries, and choose **Download all**.
- **Progress per item.** Each entry shows whether it is pending, downloading, finished or failed.
- **Safe sequential downloads.** Entries reuse the existing gateway download path, folder picker, duplicate handling and cancellation.
- **Updated API dependencies.** Runtime dependencies are refreshed and pass the high-severity npm audit gate.
